items.title: Craft CMS GraphQL越权读条目
items.summary_zh: 匿名GraphQL客户端借prev/next跨节读取隐藏条目字段，泄露内容。
items.repro_note: 匿名GraphQL查询prev/next字段，需公开端点及可见条目
items.description: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous GraphQL clients to read out-of-scope section entries via prev/next fields. Attackers can chain next hops from one visible in-scope entry to enumerate entries and read titles, slugs, and custom-field content from withheld sections.

items.title: Kyverno apiCall命名空间越权
items.summary_zh: 命名空间租户滥用apiCall路径编码绕过限制，发起跨命名空间或集群级API请求。
cwe_labels: 意图代理错误(混源下载)
items.repro_note: 租户构造urlPath百分号转义，触发跨命名空间API请求
items.impact_scope: K8s策略引擎，集群横向风险
items.description: Kyverno from 1.19.1 before 1.19.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the apiCall namespace clamp that allows namespace tenants to issue cross-namespace and cluster-scoped API requests by appending malformed percent-escapes to urlPath. Attackers can create namespaced Policies whose apiCall runs as the admission-controller ServiceAccount to read other namespaces' resources and create mutating webhooks, escalating to cluster admin.

items.title: OpenEMR传真模块文件读写RCE
items.summary_zh: 低权限认证用户经fax/sms disposeDocument的file_path穿越读写文件，可窃取凭据并RCE。
items.repro_note: 低权限调用disposeDocument，file_path穿越读写文件
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a broken access control and path traversal vulnerability in the fax/sms module disposeDocument action via an unvalidated file_path parameter. Authenticated low-privilege users can read sqlconf.php to recover database credentials and write arbitrary files as the web user, enabling remote code execution.

items.title: OpenEMR药品库存SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 低权限认证用户向Fee Sheet药品库存warehouse参数注入，盲注窃取患者数据与bcrypt哈希。
items.repro_note: 低权限登录Fee Sheet，在warehouse参数注入ORDER BY子查询
items.impact_scope: 医疗EMR，患者数据与口令哈希
items.description: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Fee Sheet drug-inventory lookup (DrugSalesService::sellDrug) that interpolates the prod[N][warehouse] POST field into an ORDER BY clause. Low-privileged authenticated users can submit Fee Sheet product lines with constant subqueries to run a time-based blind oracle, extracting patient data and users_secure bcrypt hashes.

items.title: OpenEMR服务令牌重放绕过认证
items.title_zh: OpenEMR服务令牌重放绕过认证
items.summary_zh: 持有捕获service_auth令牌者可重放并爆破PIN，建立患者门户会话泄露PHI。
items.action_zh: 升级到8.4.0，启用一次性令牌与PIN限速
items.description: OpenEMR from 7.0.1 before 8.4.0 contains a flaw in src/Common/Auth/OneTimeAuth.php that ignores the enforce_onetime_use and max_access_count flags, never revokes consumed service_auth tokens, and checks login_pin without rate limiting or strict comparison. Attackers holding a captured token can replay it or brute-force the PIN to open patient-portal sessions exposing PHI.
